chapter: 卜筮全书歌诀·六爻诸占定位
chapter_en: Verses of the Bushi Quanshu: position of each line

units.chapter: 卜筮全书歌诀·二十九、六爻诸占定位
units.chapter_en: Verses of the Bushi Quanshu, no. 29: the position of each of the six lines for the various divinations
units.title: 六位取象表·疾病：初爻足、二爻腿肢、五爻心肺、六爻头脑(三四两格原文空缺)

rule.yi: 卜筮全书的「六爻诸占定位」表里，疾病一行按初爻到六爻的次序是：足、腿肢、（空缺）、（空缺）、心肺、头脑。
rule.en: In the table of the position of the six lines for the various divinations in the Bushi Quanshu, the row for illness runs, from the first line to the sixth: the feet, legs and limbs, (missing), (missing), heart and lungs, head and brain.

en: the legs and limbs (the second line)
the heart and lungs (the fifth line)
the head and brain (the sixth line)

note.yi: 这是一张表，原书竖排，这个文件里改成横排：表头是初爻到六爻，下面每一行是一种占问（天时、家宅、身命、国事、鬼神、求谋、疾病、六畜……），按位置一格对一爻。疾病一行有两格原文模糊、无法辨认，这里没有补，只收读得出的四格：足（初爻）、腿肢（二爻）、心肺（五爻）、头脑（六爻）；「一格对一爻」是按表里的位置读的，书里没有另写说明。表前的说明（今人加的）说这一表大约是从《鬼谷分爻》辑录来的，那段说明不收。这一行和易隐引鬼谷分爻（LY.ILL.YY.02）、断易天机的鬼谷辨爻法（LY.ILL.DYTJ.01）是同一类说法，「初足、二腿、五心、六头」几家一致，三、四爻各有各的说法，见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.11 的「打架」。
note.en: This is a table, written vertically in the original and turned horizontal in this file: the head of the table is the first to sixth lines, and each row below is one kind of divination (the weather, the house, the person and life, affairs of state, spirits, seeking and planning, illness, livestock, and so on), one cell to a line by position. In the row for illness two cells are blurred in the original and cannot be made out; they are not filled in here and only the four readable cells are taken: the feet (first line), the legs and limbs (second line), the heart and lungs (fifth line) and the head and brain (sixth line); 'one cell to a line' is read by position in the table, and the book does not say so separately. The explanation before the table (added by a modern hand) says that this table seems to have been collected from 'Guigu's division of the lines', and that explanation is not quoted. This row is of the same kind as the Yi Yin's quotation of Guigu's division of the lines (LY.ILL.YY.02) and the Duanyi Tianji's table under Guigu's name (LY.ILL.DYTJ.01); 'first the feet, second the legs, fifth the heart, sixth the head' is agreed by them, and the third and fourth lines are put differently in each, see the dispute in LY.ILL.DYTJ.11.

units.chapter: 卜筮全书歌诀·二十九、六爻诸占定位
units.chapter_en: Verses of the Bushi Quanshu, no. 29: the position of each of the six lines for the various divinations
units.title: 六位取象表·鬼神：初爻井神、二爻司命、三爻家先、四爻土地、五爻社司、六爻天神

rule.yi: 卜筮全书的「六爻诸占定位」表里，鬼神一行按初爻到六爻的次序是：井神、司命、家先、土地、社司、天神。
rule.en: In the table of the position of the six lines for the various divinations in the Bushi Quanshu, the row for spirits runs, from the first line to the sixth: the well spirit, the Life-Governing Spirit, the family ancestors, the Earth God, the village altar spirit and the heavenly spirit.

en: the village altar spirit (the fifth line)

note.yi: 和上一条是同一张表的另一行，占鬼神（谁在作祟）时按爻位取象：鬼爻落在初爻是井神、二爻司命（灶君管人命的神）、三爻家先（家里的祖先）、四爻土地、五爻社司（社里管事的神）、六爻天神。同一类的爻位配鬼神，火珠林占鬼神一节也有一张（LY.ILL.HZL.05）。「一格对一爻」是按表里的位置读的。
note.en: This is another row of the same table as the last entry: in divining spirits (which one is at work) the images are taken by line position: the ghost line falling on the first line is the well spirit, on the second the Life-Governing Spirit (the hearth-god who governs a person's life), on the third the family ancestors (the ancestors of the house), on the fourth the Earth God, on the fifth the village altar spirit (the spirit in charge of the village altar) and on the sixth the heavenly spirit. The Huozhu Lin's section on divining spirits also has a table matching line positions to spirits (LY.ILL.HZL.05). 'One cell to a line' is read by position in the table.
